verdict.rationale: The evidence only hints at the story. A three.js devtools browser extension is linked from the homepage, but nothing shows it is a frame or GPU profiler. A release note about setGeometryIdAt() implies a batched-geometry path, and WebGPURenderer offers compute shaders as a GPU offload route. Missing for 10: documented real profiler (CPU/GPU frame timing), explicit instancing/batching docs, any ECS, any jobs/worker-threading model, hands-on corroboration of scaling heavy scenes.
